name: Custom Shape Wooden Number Tracker Display
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from high-quality wood for a sturdy, durable, and long-lasting display.
    - Designed with a layered wooden construction for a dimensional and eye-catching look.
    - Base layers are made from 5mm wood for strong support and stability.
    - Swing frame, swing pieces, and number cards are made from 3mm wood for a lightweight yet sturdy finish.
    - Hanging bar made from 5mm wood.
    - Number cards with a maximum of 30 cards.
    - Smooth wooden surface helps showcase printed details clearly and beautifully.
    - Freestanding design makes it suitable for shelves, desks, countertops, and display areas.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in 3 size options:
            +) 8 x 8 in ~ 20.32 x 20.32 cm - Wooden base: 8 x 3.9 in ~ 20.32 x 9.91 cm
            +) 10 x 10 in ~ 25.4 x 25.4 cm - Wooden base: 10 x 4.9 in ~ 25.4 x 12.45 cm
            +) 12 x 12 in ~ 30.48 x 30.48 cm - Wooden base: 12 x 5.9 in ~ 30.48 x 14.99 cm
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing  Technology:
    - Uses high-quality UV printing technology for sharp details, vibrant colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - Features 2-sided printing on the main wooden parts for a polished and attractive look from multiple angles.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Designed as a number tracker display for showcasing changing numbers in a fun and decorative way.
    - Includes interchangeable number cards that can be arranged based on your display needs.
    - Suitable for tracking dates, milestone numbers, countdowns, classroom numbers, or special daily displays.
    - Freestanding base allows the display to be placed easily on desks, bookshelves, tiered trays, counters, mantels, or entry tables.
    - Layered design adds depth and visual interest, making it both functional and decorative.
    - The hanging swing element creates a playful and charming display style.
    - Great for decorating libraries, reading corners, classrooms, offices, or themed home spaces.
    - Can be used as a seasonal display, daily number board, or custom room decoration.
    - Easy to assemble and easy to update with different number combinations when needed.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A great gift for book lovers, teachers, students, librarians, and Halloween decor lovers.
    - Perfect for birthdays, housewarming gifts, and personalized home decor gifts.
    - Suitable for Halloween, fall decor, and spooky-themed room decoration.
    - A thoughtful choice for library decor, classroom decor, and reading nook decoration.
    - Great for countdown displays, milestone celebrations, and themed special occasions.
    - Ideal as a unique gift for friends or family who love custom wooden decor and seasonal displays.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape Wooden Number Tracker Display

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
